definitions.full: H652. ophel אֹ֫פֶל noun masculine Job 3:6 darkness, gloom (only in poetry) - ׳א always absolute — 1 darkness ,, of night Psa 91:6 (opposed to צָֽהֳרַיִם deep in the earth, א ׳אֶבֶן Job 28:3 (|| צַלְמָוֶת חשֶׁח ); darkness, gloom of underworld 10:22 (twice in verse) (|| צַלְמָוֶת עֵיפָפָה׳א חשֶׁח אֶרֶץ ); personified 3:6 that night — let darkness take it א ׳יִקָּחֵהוּ ; figurative of spiritual darkness Isa 29:18 (|| חשֵׁח ); of secrecy, treachery Psa 11:2 . 2 especially figurative of calamity , Job 23:17 (|| ך חשׁ q. v.), 30:26 (opposed to אוֺר ).
